newsletter.markdown:
1. **Discovery & Translational Science**

* **Oligodendrocyte dysfunction identified as driver of human age-related cognitive decline** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04608-y)
  * Analyzed a human brain bank cohort supported by over 70 years of longitudinal cognitive tracking alongside experimental functional modeling.
  * Identified oligodendrocytes as primary active contributors to age-associated cognitive decline, expanding targetable mechanisms beyond classical neuronal and microglial pathology.

* **Restoring LZ⁺ MYPT1 isoform expression prevents HFpEF development in preclinical models** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.19.745871)
  * Investigated alternative splicing of exon 24 of the myosin targeting subunit 1 (MYPT1) transcript in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF).
  * Demonstrated that maintaining nitric oxide-responsive leucine-zipper-positive (LZ⁺) MYPT1 prevents impairment of vascular reactivity and halts downstream development of HFpEF.

* **Single-nucleus RNA-seq maps arrhythmogenic fibroblast remodeling in mitral regurgitation** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.19.745870)
  * Profiled left atrial posterior wall tissue via snRNA-seq in a canine model of endovascular mitral regurgitation (MR) across 4-week and 6-month time points.
  * Found that atrial fibrillation (AF) susceptibility is governed by a distinct, disease-specific fibroblast subpopulation and cell-cell signaling rather than total collagen accumulation or atrial enlargement.

* **Cobrotoxin attenuates neuroinflammation and motor deficits in Parkinson's disease models** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.org/42641192/)
  * Investigated the neuroprotective signaling mechanism of cobrotoxin in models of glia-mediated Parkinson's disease.
  * Suppressed TLR4-NF-κB and STAT1 signaling cascades, reducing neuroinflammatory activation and motor impairment.

* **Spatially restricted antigen expression via ionizable LNPs enhances mRNA vaccine potency** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.org/42641929/)
  * Formulated an ionizable lipid nanoparticle (LNP) delivery system designed to compartmentalize mRNA-encoded antigen expression.
  * Enhanced protective immune responses against *Pseudomonas aeruginosa* compared to standard LNP formulations.

* **Epigenetic biomarker proxies enable scalable multi-omic disease profiling** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.1101/2024.12.06.24318612)
  * Developed 1,694 DNA methylation-derived surrogate markers (EBPs) capturing 42 clinical traits, 689 metabolites, and 963 proteins from a single DNAm assay in 4,418 participants.
  * Replicated marker performance, clinical range detection, and disease associations across seven external cohorts totaling 57,454 individuals.

2. **Early Trials — Phase I–II**

* **[Biotech]** **Nektar publishes Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD results for rezpegaldesleukin in *The Lancet*** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2092228506675507685)
  * Detailed 16-week induction data from the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD study evaluating rezpegaldesleukin in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis.
  * Dosing at 24 μg/kg every two weeks met all primary and key secondary endpoints, achieving statistically significant improvements in EASI-75, EASI-90, Itch NRS, vIGA-AD, and affected body surface area.

* **[Biotech]** **Cytokinetics reports positive hemodynamic and mechanical outcomes with aficamten in FOREST-HCM** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.org/42641848/)
  * Evaluated the selective cardiac myosin inhibitor aficamten in patients with obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy within the open-label FOREST-HCM trial.
  * Treatment resulted in sustained improvements in left ventricular cardiac mechanics, obstruction gradients, and myocardial strain measures.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Pfizer's hexavalent maternal vaccine GBS6 demonstrates favorable safety and immunogenicity in Phase 2 trial** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.org/42641635/)
  * Evaluated GBS6 in a Phase 2 double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled study (PREPARE WP4) in pregnant women living with and without HIV and their infants in Uganda.
  * Induced robust strain-specific antibody responses with no safety signals identified across maternal or infant cohorts.

* **Movement-responsive closed-loop DBS mitigates motor fluctuations in Parkinson's disease** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.20.26360021)
  * Tested a movement-responsive deep brain stimulation (mDBS) paradigm decoding volitional motion from sensorimotor cortex in four patients with sensing-enabled implants.
  * mDBS improved average forearm speed, reduced progressive bradykinetic slowing during task execution, and demonstrated progressive cumulative symptom reduction over hours of daily use compared to continuous DBS.

* **Connectome-guided rTMS targeting CON-SCAN network achieves 50% response in neuropathic pain** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.23.26361115)
  * Conducted an open-label pilot study in 20 patients with neuropathic pain using personalized primary motor cortex rTMS localized to maximal functional connectivity with the cingulo-opercular and somato-cognitive action network (CON-SCAN).
  * Achieved a 50% clinical response rate at post-treatment and 1-month follow-up; increased CON-SCAN connectivity directly correlated with reductions in pain interference, anxiety, and depression scores.

3. **Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III**

* **[Big Pharma]** **Pfizer's crizotinib fails to show OS benefit as adjuvant therapy in Phase 3 ALK⁺ NSCLC trial** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.org/42641639/)
  * Evaluated adjuvant crizotinib versus observation or placebo in resected early-stage ALK-positive non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) in the ECOG-ACRIN E4512 Phase 3 trial.
  * Primary efficacy readout detailed disease-free and overall survival outcomes, providing randomized controlled trial evidence for targeted therapy in early-stage ALK-positive NSCLC.

* **Phase 3 trial evaluates salvage hypofractionated accelerated radiotherapy in prostate cancer recurrence** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.org/42641124/)
  * Conducted a randomized Phase 3 trial comparing salvage hypofractionated accelerated radiotherapy against standard schedules for biochemical recurrence following radical prostatectomy.
  * Evaluated comparative efficacy and late gastrointestinal/genitourinary toxicity profiles between accelerated and conventional fractions.

4. **Regulatory & Approvals**

* **[Big Pharma]** **FDA approves J&J's Imaavy (nipocalimab-aahu) as first targeted therapy for warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/news-events-human-drugs/fda-approves-first-drug-warm-autoimmune-hemolytic-anemia)
  * Granted approval for Imaavy in adult and pediatric patients aged 12 years and older with warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia (wAIHA) who have received prior corticosteroid therapy.
  * The anti-FcRn monoclonal antibody blocks IgG recirculation to reduce autoantibody-mediated destruction of red blood cells.

* **[Biotech]** **FDA grants expanded frontline clearance for Jazz and Zymeworks' Ziihera in HER2⁺ gastroesophageal cancer** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/jazz-ziihera-fda-approve-gastroesophageal-adenocarcinoma/828747/)
  * Approved Ziihera (zanidatamab) in combination with chemotherapy with or without Tevimbra (tislelizumab) for frontline HER2-positive gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma.
  * Phase 3 trial data showed the combination reduced the risk of disease progression or death by 35% and overall risk of death by 28% compared to standard Herceptin plus chemotherapy.

* **[Big Pharma]** **FDA approves GSK's Tivicay PD for HIV-1 infection in neonates from birth** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/news-events-human-drugs/fda-approves-drug-treat-hiv-infection-newborns)
  * Approved Tivicay PD (dolutegravir) oral suspension for full-term neonates (birth to 4 weeks, weighing ≥ 2 kg) as part of combination antiretroviral therapy.
  * Approval was supported by pharmacokinetics, safety, and viral suppression data from 48 neonates evaluated in the IMPAACT 2023 trial (NCT05406583).

* **[Big Pharma]** **FDA clears Roche and Eli Lilly's Elecsys pTau217 blood test for Alzheimer's diagnosis** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/roche-eli-lilly-get-fda-nod-for-new-alzheimers-blood-test/828720/)
  * Cleared the single-biomarker plasma pTau217 assay to assist clinicians in ruling in or ruling out amyloid pathology in individuals aged 55 and older with cognitive impairment.
  * Commercial laboratory availability was concurrently announced by both Labcorp and Quest Diagnostics.

* **[Big Pharma]** **FDA authorizes Abbott's Libre Duo 10 Day dual continuous glucose and ketone monitor** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-authorizes-first-wearable-device-continuously-monitors-both-ketone-levels-and-blood-sugar)
  * Granted clearance for the Libre Duo 10 Day continuous monitoring system for patients aged 2 years and older with diabetes.
  * Marks the first continuous wearable device cleared in the US to monitor ketone levels and the first globally to measure both glucose and ketones in a single sensor.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Baxter issues voluntary nationwide recall for one lot of 70% Dextrose Injection** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/baxter-issues-voluntary-nationwide-recall-one-lot-70-dextrose-injection-due-potential-presence)
  * Initiated a voluntary recall for lot number 2,000 mL VIAFLEX plastic containers of 70% Dextrose Injection, USP.
  * Prompted by internal identification of particulate matter confirmed to be stainless steel microparticles.

5. **Business & Strategy**

* **[Biotech]** **Immatics prices $150 million public offering** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2092205680660791626)
  * Priced an underwritten public offering of common shares at $8.69 per share.
  * Expected gross proceeds total approximately $150 million before underwriting discounts and transaction fees.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Teva targeted by Turkish antitrust regulators over patent practices** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/08/25/turkish-authorities-probe-teva-gaming-patent-system-disparaging-rivals/)
  * Turkish Competition Authority initiated a formal investigation into Teva Pharmaceutical.
  * Allegations involve misuse of the patent system to delay generic market entry and campaign strategies disparaging competitor products.

* **Massachusetts biopharma employment rebounds following 2025 contraction** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/25/massachusetts-biotech-slump-then-turnaround/)
  * State life sciences workforce indicators show a return to positive job growth and capital inflow in 2026.
  * Reverses the sector's first year-over-year employment drop recorded since 2002 during the 2025 biotech market correction.

* **Venture funding in women's health biopharma declines as investors favor late-stage assets** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/womens-health-startups-venture-investment-svb-report/828632/)
  * Silicon Valley Bank report indicates venture investment in women's health biopharma fell from $1.3 billion in 2024 to $610 million in 2025.
  * Contraction reflects broader deployment shifts prioritizing mature platforms and clinical-stage clinical readouts over early-stage research.

6. **Public Health & Policy**

* **Pennsylvania reports first US measles fatalities of 2026** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/25/two-measles-deaths-reported-pennsylvania-residents-not-vaccinated/)
  * State health officials confirmed two deaths from measles in unvaccinated Pennsylvania residents.
  * Represents the first confirmed measles-related deaths recorded in the United States this calendar year.

* **Armed conflict and aid reductions disrupt malaria, TB, and HIV control in eastern DRC** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04592-3)
  * Escalating violence in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo alongside major humanitarian funding cuts has severely disrupted treatment and surveillance programs.
  * Unchecked transmission of malaria, tuberculosis, and HIV threatens health system collapse beyond existing viral outbreak responses.

* **Behavioral dynamics in built environments govern US seasonal influenza transmission** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.21.26360922)
  * Integrated high-resolution case tracking with human mobility data to model influenza invasion dynamics across temperate and subtropical US regions.
  * Revealed that summer indoor crowding in southeastern states creates persistent reservoirs that seed nationwide winter epidemics as early as August.

**Worth watching:** The expanded FDA approval of Jazz and Zymeworks' Ziihera in frontline HER2⁺ gastroesophageal cancer sets up a direct clinical matchup against Herceptin biosimilar standards, with adoption likely driven by its 35% reduction in progression risk.

youtube.markdown:
- Biology & Health
    - [90% of AI Scribes Will Die](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/duCFly39asM) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Dr. Thomas Kelly asserts that approximately 90% of AI medical scribes will fail to survive in the healthcare market.
        - Safety benchmarks will serve as the primary deciding factor determining which AI scribe tools persist.
        - Patient safety and benchmark compliance are critical evaluation criteria for medical AI technologies.
- Tech & Engineering
    - [Why the Ikea Business Model Wins](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2gpRaJMjHbc) -- Wendover Productions
        - The production was written by Sam Denby, Tristan Purdy, and Christine Benedetti for Wendover Productions.
        - Visual animation was produced by Sara Stoltman, Gabriel Ferreras, Austin Glass, and Kate Ermolenko, with editing by Alexander Williard.
        - Sound design was created by Manni Simon and Dony Bullen, with thumbnail artwork designed by Simon Buckmaster.
- Other
    - [Earthquake Resistant Buildings](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/uwCbFDsma7Q) -- CrashCourse
        - Earthquakes occur unpredictably across the globe without precise capabilities to forecast their exact time or location.
        - Scientists collect and track seismic data to improve statistical forecasts and assess risk levels.
        - Ongoing research focuses on developing preventative measures and structural protections against severe seismic shocks.
